typography.instructions: Import Rajdhani and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts in index.css or index.html.

visual_enhancers.plugin_luminous_edge: Relative container with an absolute pseudo-element inset-[-1px] bg-gradient-to-br from-[#FFD700] to-[#00E5FF] rounded-xl z-[-1] opacity-50 blur-[2px]
visual_enhancers.buttons: bg-transparent border border-[#00E5FF] text-[#00E5FF] hover:bg-[#00E5FF]/10 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.5)] transition-colors duration-300
visual_enhancers.surfaces: No pure transparent backgrounds under content. Always use #141416 or glassmorphism with opacity > 80%.

screen_1_creative_engine.description: Simulated DAW decor with a floating central plugin window.
screen_1_creative_engine.daw_background: Left sidebar (Synth 1/2 tracks), top transport bar (124 BPM, play/stop), right mixer panel. Muted colors, dark grays.
screen_1_creative_engine.plugin_window: Centered floating modal. Anthracite background (#141416), luminous edges.
screen_1_creative_engine.plugin_header: FREKANSLA title, 'FREK CORE connected' (green dot), 'L2 Secured' badge.
screen_1_creative_engine.sonic_flow: Central wide block showing animated waveform (gold/blue).
screen_1_creative_engine.macro_controls: Bottom section with 4 controls: WARM ANALOG (slider/knob), INTENTION MORPH (central 2D XY pad), HARMONIC AGGRESSION (slider/knob), SPATIAL DEPTH (slider/knob).

screen_2_certification_portal.description: Dashboard for .FK object creation and verification.
screen_2_certification_portal.left_column: 4-step vertical pipeline (Session Analyzer, Asset Compiler, FK Object Creator, Secure Signature). Use a vertical stepper with glowing active nodes.
screen_2_certification_portal.right_column: .FK Explorer and Diagnostics Console. Terminal-like black background, green/blue mono text.
screen_2_certification_portal.bottom_action_bar: Sticky bottom bar with PACKAGE AS .FK OBJECT, EXPORT AUDIO, SECURE & PUBLISH TO KORA buttons.

components.intention_morph_sphere: A framer-motion drag container. Parent: relative, circular or square boundary border-white/10. Child: glowing sphere (radial gradient gold to blue) with 'drag' enabled.
components.sonic_flow_visualizer: Use a flex container of narrow vertical motion.divs with changing heights and bg-gradients (gold/blue) to simulate real-time audio.
components.diagnostics_console: Terminal aesthetic. Black background, monospace font, lines appearing sequentially to simulate 'inspect, check, verify, doctor'.
components.status_badges: Pill-shaped, uppercase, thin font, 1px solid border matching the status color with a 10% opacity background of the same color.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform). Do not use 'transition-all'.
motion.hover_states: Buttons and knobs must glow slightly on hover (box-shadow).
motion.sonic_flow: Continuous subtle height animation for waveform bars using Framer Motion.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic centered layouts (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, draggable spheres) MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Use Rajdhani for all headings and JetBrains Mono for all data/technical readouts.
Ensure contrast requirements are met (APCA/WCAG). Use light text on dark backgrounds.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. If an avatar or logo is needed, use lucide-react icons as fallbacks.
Create custom components in .js extensions (e.g. /app/frontend/src/components/ui/button.js). Do not use .tsx.
Maintain the 'Anthracite & Neon' Pro-Audio VST plugin aesthetic strictly. Use heavy technical UI paradigms.
